name: scsi_pair
label: SCSI pair (two 61 cm Dobsonians), north-south, 2-3 m
sources: Horch et al. 2026, arXiv:2601.13447 (SCSI paper II), Table 2: north-south separations 2.061-3.005 m on the Arcturus nights (Telescope 2 north of Telescope 1)
notes: baseline_m 2.2 is the typical 2025 separation; set per night through instrument.array_params or options.baseline_schedule.
